title: Pin and read hosted source
responsibility: Resolve repository refs into a cache identity and read regular artifacts with verified content bindings.

inputs.name: hubSource.input
inputs.type: { source: SourceHistoryAdapter; cache: CollaborationCache; actor: Actor; project: Project & { collaborationCommit?: string }; ref: string; }
inputs.description: Supplies the adapter, cache, actor, project, and ref used to resolve project.sourceRepository and build the context. project.collaborationCommit is optional and is recorded as null when absent.

inputs.name: hubRead.context
inputs.description: Carries the source adapter, repository, pinned commit, tree entries, cache identity, and cache used by the read. Only matching blob entries with mode 100644 or 100755 are eligible.

inputs.name: hubRead.path
inputs.description: Exact path looked up in context.entries. Only blob entries with type blob and mode 100644 or 100755 are accepted.

inputs.name: hubRead.hash
inputs.description: Optional hash passed with the raw blob to hubMaterializedHash; it defaults to null. hubRead forwards it unchanged.

outputs.name: hubSource
outputs.description: Pins project.sourceRepository at the resolved commit and loads that commit tree into entries. The identity records actor, project, repository, requested ref, source commit/tree, nullable notes/evidence and collaboration revisions, while historyIndexRevision, artifactHash, and profile start null.

outputs.name: hubRead
outputs.description: Returns raw bytes for a non-LFS blob. For an LFS blob it returns a same-sized cached value, or reads bytes at the pinned commit/path, checks their length against the binding, caches them, and returns them.

errors.name: SourceHistoryAdapter rejection
errors.description: hubSource rejects if resolve, either optionalRef call, or tree rejects; the rejection is not translated in this function.

errors.name: hubFail('not-found')
errors.description: hubRead calls hubFail('not-found') when context.entries has no exact-path blob with mode 100644 or 100755.

errors.name: hubFail()
errors.description: hubRead calls hubFail() when source.read returns bytes whose length differs from binding.size.

errors.name: hubRead dependency rejection
errors.description: Rejections from hubRaw, hubMaterializedHash, readCache, context.source.read, or writeCache propagate from hubRead.
